response.text:
Here are the deadlines coming up in October:

- **Return overdue library books** to Stadtbibliothek Musterstadt — due Fri 2 Oct 2026 [item:itm_ghq58jjdz149]. Fees keep rising the longer they're overdue, per the letter.
- **Decide whether to object (Widerspruch)** to Muster BKK's contribution notice — due Wed 14 Oct 2026, so it should be sent by Thu 8 Oct 2026 [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg]. Note: even if you object, the assessed amount must still be paid in the meantime, as an objection has no suspensive effect.
- **Mobile contract (FunkNetz Smart M) cancellation window** — if you want to cancel, it must arrive by Wed 14 Oct 2026, so post it by Thu 8 Oct 2026; the current term otherwise runs to Sat 14 Nov 2026 [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2].

You can mark the library and objection to-dos done, or draft a cancellation letter for the mobile contract, directly in Ordnung.
